help.title: Help Menu
help.description: Use `{prefix}help <command>` for more information on a command.
Show all commands or details of one command.

language.description: Show or change the bot language for this server.

prefix.description: Change the bot's prefix for this server.

join.description: Join the voice channel you are currently in.

loop.description: Set the loop mode: off, track, or queue (no argument cycles through them).

nowplaying.description: Show the song that is currently playing.

play.description: Play a song (name or URL) or add it to the queue.

random.description: Play a random song (optionally from a genre or artist).

remove.description: Remove a song from the queue by its position.

stop.description: Stop playback and clear the queue (the bot stays in the channel).

247.description: Keep the bot in the voice channel even when nothing is playing.

idletime.description: Show or set how long the bot waits before leaving an idle voice channel.

settings.description: Show all bot settings for this server.

invite.description: Get a link to add the bot to another server.

stay.statusOn:
24/7 mode is **on**. I stay in the voice channel even when nothing is playing.
Turn it off with `{prefix}247 off`.
stay.statusOff:
24/7 mode is **off**. I leave after **{minutes}** minute(s) of inactivity.
Turn it on with `{prefix}247 on`.
stay.enabled: 24/7 mode **enabled**. I won't leave the voice channel because of inactivity (`leave` still works).
stay.disabled: 24/7 mode **disabled**. I'll leave after **{minutes}** minute(s) of inactivity.

idletime.current:
I leave an idle voice channel after **{minutes}** minute(s).
Change it with `{prefix}idletime <minutes>`.
idletime.currentDefault:
I leave an idle voice channel after **{minutes}** minute(s) (default).
Change it with `{prefix}idletime <minutes>`.
idletime.reset: Idle time reset to the default (**{minutes}** minute(s)).
idletime.invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from {min} to {max}, e.g. `{prefix}idletime 5`. Use `{prefix}idletime reset` for the default.
idletime.stayNote: Note: 24/7 mode is on, so this has no effect until you run `{prefix}247 off`.
